repo.description:
### Summary

An authorization gap in the upload endpoint allows any authenticated user - even those without the `documents.add_document` permission - to upload and ingest documents. This enables "read-only" users to create documents and consume storage/processing resources - bypassing intended restrictions.

  _Expected_
  - The request (1) should return `403 Forbidden` and no task should be created for users lacking `documents.add_document`.
repo.summary: Read‑only users can create documents via post_document endpoint
